desc: 暖砂陶橙晚光体系：痛点清单、画质对比、双轴结构、三装法与参数收口
name: 暖砂陶橙双向云台摄像机款

shots.intent: 首屏用暖砂晚光加浅石台把双段云台机型的轮廓与哑光质感一次立住，抢一眼点击
shots.textZone: upper-left two-line headline with a square tick, one support line beneath, one row of three sharp-corner tick chips above the product

shots.intent: 把离家后看不见、听不到、来不及三类焦虑摊成编号清单，先共鸣再给方案
shots.textZone: top headline plus one support line, one ordinal tick and one short problem line per card

shots.intent: 同一暖光房间同框两栏，一侧糊一侧利落，把成像差距变成一眼可读的画面差
shots.textZone: top two-line headline, one caption pill under each panel

shots.intent: 侧面同框两个朝向加两圈转向弧线，把双轴可转讲成可见结构而不报任何角度数
shots.textZone: upper-left two-line headline, one support line, two labels on hairline leader lines at the arc terminators

shots.intent: 把手机靠在暖光边桌上显示家里客厅实时画面，给出尺度参照也给出使用结果
shots.textZone: upper-right two-line headline plus one support line, one label on a hairline leader at the phone edge

shots.intent: 俯视桌面上摄像机与手机并置，两枚对话气泡把远程喊话这件抽象事变成可见动作
shots.textZone: one headline at the top left, one short line inside each speech bubble

shots.intent: 掠射光下的哑光壳体与亮面黑罩、镜筒圈与指示灯微距，用做工代替形容词
shots.textZone: right-hand headline plus one support line and one hairline leader label at the seam

shots.intent: 桌面、壁架、顶部吊装三格同框，把摆放自由度变成可选路径并顺带消除安装顾虑
shots.textZone: top two-line headline plus one caption chip under each panel

shots.intent: 两栏结构化信息表一次答完规格疑问，所有取值只走占位符以免虚构
shots.textZone: headline above the table, one field name and one placeholder value per row

shots.intent: 回到首屏石台与斜光，用一句主张加一枚陶土橙方钮完成收口转化
shots.textZone: two-line headline above the product, one support line, one sharp-corner action button at the lower centre

style.backgroundSystem: seamless warm plaster wall #F1E8DC meeting an oat linen surface #D9C7B0 with one shallow rectangular stone slab step; information screens sit on #F7F2EA plates built from sharp-corner cards; one recurring thin signal-arc line drawn in #C4623C marks every screen corner; depth comes only from the slab step and the long raking shadow, never from gradients, never from a cylindrical podium or marble
style.iconSystem: single-weight 1.5pt #2A2C31 line icons on sharp-corner #F7F2EA chips, small filled square numbered ticks instead of circles, thin signal-arc and concentric-ring glyphs in #C4623C, flat hairline dividers; no 3D medallions, no seal badges, no gold outlines, no cloud motifs
style.lightingSystem: low warm key at about 3400K entering from the right at a shallow 25-degree rake, one large linen-softened left bounce, every shadow long and pointing left in one consistent direction, a single controlled specular streak across the glossy face mask while the matte body stays non-reflective, warm practical glow inside scene frames
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm domestic watch-tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a warm sand plaster field #F1E8DC, an oat linen surface #D9C7B0 and a clean copy plate #F7F2EA, one clay-orange accent #C4623C, one moss-grey secondary #6E7A63 and #2A2C31 text; warm low light at about 3400K raking in from the right at a shallow 25-degree angle with a soft linen left bounce, long single-direction shadows pointing left, one controlled specular on the gloss face mask and a matte body that stays non-reflective; seamless plaster wall meeting an oat linen tabletop with one shallow rectangular stone slab step, depth only from the step and the shadow rake, never from gradients and never from a marble podium; one condensed modern sans Chinese family, left-aligned two-line headlines led by a small filled square tick, hairline leader lines with dot terminators, muted #6E7A63 micro-labels, all Chinese copy wrapped in corner brackets and written only as placeholders; single-weight 1.5pt #2A2C31 line icons on sharp-corner #F7F2EA chips, numbered square ticks instead of circles, thin #C4623C signal-arc and concentric-ring glyphs, no 3D medallions, no seal badges, no gold outlines, no cloud motifs; the product keeps one identical two-part silhouette everywhere: a near-spherical head with a large oval gloss-black face mask centred on the lens and one tiny indicator LED above the barrel, riding on a rounded conical matte base wider than the head, pan-tilt rotation being the only articulated move, the white body never recoloured, always resting in contact with a surface, never held by a hand; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented spec numbers, no angle figures, no certifications, no brand wordmark.
noDrift: no rotation, pan or tilt angle figures and no degree symbols
no resolution, pixel-count, aperture or frame-rate numbers
no load capacity, weight, dimensions or size figures
no battery life, power, voltage or working-temperature range
no material grade wording such as 航空铝 or 碳纤维, no plastic grade codes
no certifications, test reports, awards or standard numbers
no brand or store wordmark, no QR code, no membership or promo badge
no hand touching or gripping the rotating head
no camera hanging from an unsecured ceiling mount
no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles
no cylindrical marble podium, no gradient background, no cut-off product edges
style.presentationRules: one identical two-part silhouette on every screen: a near-spherical head carrying a large oval gloss-black face mask centred on the lens with one tiny indicator LED above the barrel, riding on a rounded conical matte base that is wider than the head; head rotation on its pan-tilt axis is the only articulated move; the white body is never recoloured; both parts always rest in contact with a surface; the head is never held, gripped or touched by a hand; no lens or sensor array is invented
style.surfaceSystem: oat linen tabletop #D9C7B0, one shallow rectangular stone slab #E4D8C6, warm plaster wall #F1E8DC, a pale oak shelf edge in scene shots, #F7F2EA copy plates for infographic screens
style.typography: one condensed modern sans Chinese family (Source Han Sans / 思源黑体 weights); left-aligned two-line #2A2C31 headlines led by a small filled square tick, one hairline leader with a dot terminator for labels, muted #6E7A63 micro-labels, Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」 and always carried as placeholders, no serif and no calligraphic type
